guyyaa tokko iyyuu waan kana hojjechuu hin dadhabu;

Akka namni tokko iyyuu achiin hin dabarreef
Ergasii iddoon jireenya ishee hin badu

Kanaafuu guyyaa ani itti dhugaa baʼu eeggadhu"

yaa Israaʼel sagalee ol fudhadhuu iyyi!
ati lammata balaa tokko illee hin sodaattu.
